_comment: What the map cannot resolve, as it stood when the ratchet was introduced. BOTH lists may only SHRINK. `computed`: imports whose target is built at RUN TIME — resolve the name at build time rather than adding an entry, because every one removed turns a blind spot into a proven edge. `unread`: files nothing in the tree imports — each is either dead or reached in a way no parse tree can see (a route, a shell script, a registry).
